rca_of_the_issue: Prior iter209 exposed that create_notification did not accept/persist company_id even though notify_org_admins passed company_id=org_id (would have raised TypeError at runtime, and any direct call would have produced notifications with no company_id). Main agent fix: added company_id + company_name kwargs to create_notification signature, added auto-derivation from recipient user's company_id/active_org_id when not passed, added lookup of company_name from db.companies when only id known, and included both fields in the persisted mongo doc. Verified end-to-end: new notifications produced by both direct helper calls and notify_org_admins correctly carry company_id + company_name; cross-company routing via POST /open unchanged and still passes all scenarios.
